pr.title: feat(cli): roll the Windows service log over a size cap
pr.body:
feat(cli): roll the Windows service log over a size cap

<!-- git-stk:description -->
Caps the Windows service log so a long-running service doesn't grow `navi.log` unbounded.

The logon task appends navi's output to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\navi\navi.log` via a PowerShell `*>>` redirect, so navi doesn't own the handle and can't rotate the file while it's running (Windows keeps it locked). Instead the task action now rolls the log to `navi.log.1` when it's over 10 MiB, checked each time the task starts — so growth is capped across restarts (upgrades, logon, reboot).

Note: within a single very-long-running session the log can still exceed the cap until the next restart; a fully in-session rolling log would mean navi owning the log writer (a larger change), left as a possible follow-up.

Closes #31.
<!-- /git-stk:description -->

<!-- git-stk:closes -->
Closes #31
